# make.ge - AI Assistants, Autonomous Agents & No-Code Automation

> make.ge is Georgia's premier educational and implementation portal for No-Code workflow automation (Make.com, n8n), AI Agent architectures (MCP, ReAct), and local LLMs (Ollama, DeepSeek, Llama), authored and taught by Giorgi Basilaia.

## Core Offerings

- [AI Assistants, Agents & No-Code Automation Course](https://make.ge/): 17.5-hour intensive course (7 sessions, Smart Academy) covering visual integration, Webhooks, API automation, local vector databases (Qdrant), and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- [Make.ge Shortener Infrastructure](https://make.ge/): High-performance URL routing and tracking for digital workflows.
- [Corporate AI Automation Training](https://chatgpt.ge/corporate-training.html): Enterprise workflow digitization, CRM automation, and internal tool creation without code.

## Key Technologies Covered

- **Visual Automation Platforms:** Make.com, n8n (Self-hosted & Cloud), Zapier.
- **AI Agent Frameworks:** Model Context Protocol (MCP), Claude Projects, Custom GPTs, LangChain basics.
- **Local & Open Models:** Ollama, DeepSeek R1, Llama 3, Qdrant vector databases.
- **Web Scraping & Retrieval:** Firecrawl, Apify, Webhooks, JSON parsing.
